ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms abuse cases, a rate-limit policy and the unbounded-requests flag are declared; it does not test any live limit.
offer: Model misuse and enforce bounded access at the relevant public boundary. A documented limit needs separate live evidence before it can claim effective abuse resistance.

minimal.reason: List the abuse cases modelled, such as credential stuffing. Without scenarios limits are guesses, so name each misuse.

mid.reason: Declare the rate-limit policy at the public boundary. An undeclared limit means unbounded use, so state the thresholds.

maximal.reason: Set unbounded public requests to false. A public endpoint with no bound invites abuse, so enforce a limit.
